text: Long catch-up with Erin over coffee. Her brother Dafydd got engaged in Lisbon last weekend, wedding probably next summer. Her mum is already planning the party and has opinions about everything. Erin's half marathon is May 14 and she's dreading the hills, she's only done 15k in training so far. Her partner Wei is doing it too but he's annoyingly relaxed about it.
Xavier's band has a gig at the Lexington on Friday at 9pm. He's nervous because it's their first one with the new drummer. Text him good luck that afternoon.
Kate and Tariq celebrating ten years married on June 3rd. They're doing a weekend in Whitby. Should get them a card, she loves anything with puffins on.
Caught up with Giulia. Her daughter's piano recital is the 12th at half 6 at St Mary's. Giulia's husband Henrik can't make it, he's in Oslo for work that week, so she's a bit gutted.
Dinner with Andile and Zara. Andile starts at the new firm Monday. Zara's dad had his knee done last week and is recovering at theirs, which is chaos with the toddler. Zara looked shattered.

Isabel's play opens 11/7, she's got the lead. It's an adaptation of Jane Eyre at the Old Vic studio. She's been rehearsing four nights a week and her husband Victor says she recites lines in her sleep. Her mum is coming down from Glasgow for opening night. Tickets go on sale tomorrow morning at 10, need to get two before they go.
Wei called. His parents' 40th anniversary party is Saturday at 7, at the Golden Dragon. Gift hint: his mum has been wanting a proper photo album for the old prints.
Rahul's engagement is off. He and Zoe split up last month. He's staying at his brother's for now. Check in with him next week.

Ran into Mrs Kim at the shop, her grandson Kaito won the regional chess competition on Saturday. She was beaming. He's off to the nationals in Birmingham on March 14th and she's going with him on the train that morning. Apparently he wants to study maths at Cambridge. Her other grandson Felix is the sporty one, plays rugby for the school.
Saskia is running the Berlin marathon September 27. She's been training since March and her calves are wrecked. Her partner Dafydd is flying out with her the Thursday before.
Remind me to ring Felix tomorrow afternoon about his sister's wedding on the 22nd, he wanted help with the speech.
Laura's son Milan has his grade 5 violin exam on 4/30 at 2pm. He's really anxious about the scales part. Laura says he practises in the bathroom because the echo helps.
Sophie and her husband just got back from their anniversary trip to Rome. Fifteen years. She said they did a cooking class and it was the highlight.
Call with Gintaras. His daughter Rin is playing in the under-14 cup final on Sunday at 11. He's coaching, so he's more nervous than she is. Ask him how it went Monday.
Zoe mentioned her mum's 70th is August 8th. They're doing a surprise lunch, I'm bringing the cake. Zoe's brother Victor is flying in from Toronto for it.
Haircut Thursday at 4:30. Pick up dry cleaning on the way back.
Yusuf proposed to Mariam on the beach in Cornwall on Saturday! She said yes obviously. Send them both congrats, and don't forget to ask about a date.

Abebe's choir has a concert at the cathedral December 6th at 7:30. He's got a short solo in the second half, his first ever. He's been practising every night and his wife Imani says the neighbours now know the words. Their son Yusuf is home from uni that weekend so they're all going. Abebe said he'd love it if a few of us came.
Hemi's dog Kiwi went missing yesterday evening near the park. Hemi's beside himself. Share the poster on the neighbourhood group.
Imani is vegan, worth remembering for the barbecue on the 19th. Her partner Catalina does the cooking in that house anyway.

Quick drink with Henrik after work. His brother is getting married in Copenhagen on July 18th and Henrik's best man. He hasn't started the speech and is quietly panicking. His wife Lucy keeps sending him YouTube examples which isn't helping. They fly out the 15th in the morning.
Caroline's 25th wedding anniversary was yesterday. I completely forgot. Need to send her and Tariq something this week, maybe flowers.
Lucy's nephew is in the school production of Oliver on March 20th. She's taking her mum on the Friday night.
Spoke briefly with Kaito Nakamura, he's moved to Leeds for the new job and loves it. Plays five-a-side on Tuesdays now.
Erin said her parents renewed their vows on 9/12 in the garden. Her dad cried through the whole thing. She'll send me the photos.
Tariq's racing in the Brighton 10k on Sunday morning at 9. Last year he pulled a hamstring halfway, so he's cautious. Cheer at the 7k mark.
Xav (Xavier) asked if I'd come to his brother's stag in Dublin, 14th to 16th of next month. Need to check flights before Friday.

Talked to Andile on the phone tonight. His mum is out of hospital after the fall on the 2nd but still very wobbly. His sister Imani is staying with her until the end of the month. He sounded tired. I should take him for a pint at the weekend.
Gift idea for Giulia: she keeps mentioning a nice set of watercolours.

Isabel Barros and her fiance Felix have set the date, October 3rd next year, in Porto. Save the dates coming in January. She's already stressing about the seating plan because her parents are divorced.
Sophie's daughter Zara (little Zara, not Zara from work) had her first ballet show on Saturday. Sophie said she froze for about a minute and then nailed it.
Remind me: Victor's gig with the jazz trio, Thursday the 9th at 8pm, Hare and Hounds. Book a table.
Milan's band won the battle of the bands at uni! Final was last night. Text him congrats.
Kate's mum passed away on the 3rd. Funeral is Wednesday at 11 at the crematorium. Kate's holding up but her younger brother is really struggling. Must send flowers to the house before then.
Dafydd says Saskia hates surprises, so no surprise party for her 40th. Dinner instead, March 2nd, somewhere quiet.
Laura and Gintaras are celebrating their first anniversary next Friday. Paper anniversary, she said, so he's making her a pop-up book. Very sweet. Don't mention it to Laura.
Booked the car in for its MOT on 6/2 at 8am. Drop it off and walk to work.

Wei's cousin is getting married in Kuala Lumpur over Christmas and the whole family is going. Wei is weirdly anxious about the flights with two kids. He wants recommendations for long-haul with toddlers. I'll ask Rahul, he did it last year.
Zoe's first ever triathlon is Saturday, May 23rd, starts at 7am. She's terrified of the open-water swim. Wish her luck Friday night.
Imani's recital got cancelled, the venue flooded. They're trying to rebook for spring.
Rin Jensen from book club is a big Studio Ghibli fan, has the whole collection on blu-ray. Also allergic to nuts.
Hemi and his wife Rin are expecting their second in February. Their eldest is going to be a big sister and is very excited about it. Hemi said Rin's had awful morning sickness this time round.
Did I ever ask Caroline how her son's driving test went? It was last Tuesday. Message her.
Abebe's daughter graduates from Edinburgh July 2nd at 2pm. The whole family's going up, his parents too. He's so proud. Card before she goes.
Felix said Catalina's having a tough time at work, her boss is making her redo the whole pitch. Her big presentation is the 17th at 10am.
Yusuf's band is playing the summer fete on 8/15. Mariam's doing face painting. They asked if I'd do the raffle, I said yes.

Long call with Mariam tonight, mostly about her sister Isabel. Isabel and her husband are separating after six years. Mariam's been driving down every weekend to help with the kids. Their mum doesn't know yet. Mariam's own anniversary with Yusuf is November 30 and she said they'll probably skip doing anything. I should send her something nice that week anyway, and check in with her on Sunday.
Rahul's daughter is in the regional swimming gala on Saturday afternoon. She's ten and has qualified for two finals. Ask him Sunday how she did.
Weekly shop, then gym. Nothing much else.
Victor's mum has her hip operation booked for May 9 at 8am. He's taking the week off to look after her. Pop round with soup.

Coffee with Saskia. She and Dafydd have finally booked their wedding venue, a barn near Hay-on-Wye, for June 21st. Her brother Milan is officiating. She also mentioned she's just started pottery classes on Wednesday evenings and is obsessed.
Henrik and Lucy's anniversary dinner is booked for the 5th at 7:30 at the Italian place. I'm babysitting their twins.
Note: Gintaras is coeliac, his wife Laura isn't. Their son plays rugby for the county now.
Kaito asked about tickets for the Arctic Monkeys gig on 10/24. Check if Xavier still has his spare.

Erin's running club relay is tomorrow at 6pm. Then on Saturday morning she's racing the Parkrun anniversary event, and Sunday at 2 it's her nephew's christening. Busy weekend for her. Text her Sunday night to see how it all went.

Zara and her husband have been married 30 years on April 4th. Their kids are throwing a party at the cricket club, the Saturday after at 3pm. Zara said her husband wants nothing, but she joked he'd love a new fishing reel.
Catalina mentioned her grandad is turning 90 on 1/18. Big family do in Valencia. She's flying out the Wednesday before.
Talked to Tariq after the match. His team lost the semi-final on penalties and he's gutted. His wife Kate said he's barely spoken since. Message him in a few days.
Kate Olsen's daughter Sophie got into the Royal Ballet School summer intensive. Starts July 8. Kate is over the moon and a bit terrified about the cost.

Giulia Bianchi popped round. Her parents' golden wedding is on 5/20 and she's organising a party at the village hall for the Saturday after, starts at 4pm. Her brother Milan is meant to be helping but keeps going quiet on the group chat. She's doing a slideshow of old photos and asked if I could scan some from Mum's albums. Gift hint: her parents have always wanted to go back to Lake Como. Need to sort the scans by the 10th.
